items.title: Staff Product Manager, Crypto
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is making a high-stakes bet on crypto markets right now, and this role owns the full product surface for crypto within the US app — 15-minute markets, hourly markets, weekly markets, strike markets, up/down markets across assets. You'll be setting the roadmap, coordinating execution, and making the calls that determine whether we win or lose market share against our competitors. This is a hands-on role with real ownership. The mandate is clear: grow Polymarket's share of crypto markets, starting with the US app. Crypto markets are technically complex — with real market structure considerations, liquidity dynamics, and resolution mechanisms that matter — but the audience we're building for is retail. That tension, between crypto depth and consumer simplicity, is exactly what this role has to resolve. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Define and own the product roadmap for crypto markets in the US app, including prioritization across market formats, resolution mechanisms, and trader-facing features - Coordinate with engineering and design to ship and iterate on 15-minute, hourly, and weekly crypto markets, keeping execution tight and timelines honest - Work directly with market makers to understand liquidity constraints and improve the structure of strike and up/down markets - Analyze trader behavior, volume data, and liquidity metrics to identify where the product is falling short and what to build next - Run structured experiments on market formats, resolution mechanisms (including VWAP and TWAP), and retail onboarding flows to find what drives engagement and retention - Track competitive positioning against Kalshi and other platforms, and translate that into concrete product decisions - Represent the crypto product surface in cross-functional planning, making sure engineering, design, and business stakeholders are aligned on what matters and why WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5+ years of product management experience at a consumer-facing company, with a track record of shipping high-impact features as a senior IC - Deep working knowledge of crypto markets, including major assets, market dynamics, and how retail traders think about and interact with crypto products - Hands-on experience with trading product concepts including order books, market structure, and price resolution mechanisms such as VWAP or TWAP - Demonstrated ability to move fast in an ambiguous environment, make prioritization calls under pressure, and own outcomes end to end - Strong analytical instincts — comfortable pulling and interpreting data to inform product decisions, not just relying on intuition - Clear, direct communication style that works across engineering, design, and external partners like market makers - (Plus) Direct experience working with market makers or liquidity providers on product or market structure decisions - (Plus) Prior exposure to prediction markets, information markets, or event-based trading products BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $400,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

items.title: Software Engineer, Tokens and Prompt Structures
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role: The Encodings Infra team maintains the libraries that engineers and researchers across Anthropic use to encode text and multimodal data into a form that Claude can consume. It also determines Claude’s prompt shape: how a user’s turn is represented to the model, how Claude calls tools and receives tool results, and so on. As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll own the design and maintenance of these libraries—keeping their APIs intuitive, their performance sharp, and their abstractions solid enough that most of the org never has to think about encodings or prompt structures at all. You’ll have the satisfaction of knowing that your work enabled Claude to learn new ways of understanding the world. This role is unusually broad: your work will touch systems across the codebase, from pretraining to finetuning to the API, and you'll collaborate closely with both researchers and engineers to make sure new encoding ideas can move quickly from experiment to production. Responsibilities: Maintain and improve the encoding libraries used by engineers and researchers across Anthropic Run experiments to determine the optimal way to feed structured data into Claude without confusing it Design data structures and abstractions that shield most of the organization from the details of how encoded data works while enabling “power users” Adapt the encoding libraries to support new research directions as they emerge, and make sure that we can ship these research ideas to production Optimize encoding performance across the systems that depend on these libraries You may be a good fit if you: Have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent maintaining libraries, SDKs, or developer-facing APIs Have familiarity with ML terminology and LLM architecture — you don't need to be an ML expert, but enough understanding to work effectively alongside researchers and understand the results of experiments Have experience carrying out complex refactors in large codebases Have strong communication skills and enjoy working closely with researchers and engineers to understand what they need Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact Pick up slack, even if it goes outside your job description Care about the societal impacts of your work Strong candidates may also have experience with: Tokenizers or other text/data encoding systems Maintaining a widely-used library over a long period of time Performance optimization Python and/or Rust Reinforcement learning or model training infrastructure Representative projects: Working with a research team to ship a new multimodal data type (audio, video, etc) to production Redesigning a core abstraction so that we can change how data is encoded into Claude without breaking downstream teams The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Product Owner
items.description: About us EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. About the role We are looking for a Product Owner to take ownership of the Players domain within our GamMatrix platform — the systems that govern how a player is registered, authenticated, consented, classified and protected across every operator on our platform. This is a backend platform product role, not a front-end or marketing role. The person in this seat owns functionality that is regulatory-critical and consumed by dozens of operators and internal products (MoneyMatrix, DataMatrix, CasinoEngine, PIMS). Requirements must be precise, edge cases must be thought through, and compliance implications must be understood before development starts. You will work inside an established delivery structure: a quarterly commitment cycle and two-week sprints, alongside a Tech Lead, developers and QAs, with Product Management, PMO, Integration Management and Account Management as your main stakeholders. What You'll get to do: Product and requirements ownership Own the vision, backlog and prioritisation for the Players domain, and be accountable for the business value delivered by the team. Translate business and regulatory requests into structured requirements: BRDs, user flows, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation clear enough that the team can build without ambiguity. Run discovery and business analysis continuously — with operators, Account Management, Compliance and dependent product teams — rather than as a one-off phase. Understand and document ownership boundaries and integration dependencies between the Players domain and Wallets, KYC/AML, payments, reporting and game management. Quarterly (macro) cycle T-shirting: review and size incoming work within the 10-business-day SLA, clarifying gaps and coordinating with technical stakeholders. Q Planning: bring only viable, unblocked, functionally understood and sized items forward; assess likely spillover from the current quarter; confirm the final quarterly commitment. Q Start: convert each committed item into a properly configured, traceable local EPIC (linked planning item, correct fix version, labels, preserved sizing) and set up the backlog and dashboards for tracking. Q Review: give an accurate, unvarnished view of progress at the midpoint, flag risks and dependencies early, and propose scope adjustments that protect the highest-value outcomes. Q Big Demo: represent the team company-wide — prepare and present what was delivered, why it matters commercially, and the metrics that support it. Sprint (micro) cycle Bring a prioritized, Definition-of-Ready-compliant list of work into Sprint Planning: requirements validated with the team, no blockers, dependencies resolved, dev and QA estimates in place. Prepare and lead refinement sessions (typically twice per sprint) and maintain a rolling buffer of at least two sprints of refined, ready work. Stay close to delivery in daily standups, unblock and clarify quickly, and take deep discussions offline. Support release readiness, validation and post-release verification and participate in production investigations and incident follow-ups for the domain. Scope and stakeholder management Handle stakeholder communication directly, including operator-facing and cross-BU discussions. Manage in-quarter scope changes by offsetting new work against existing commitments of similar effort, keeping capacity balanced and delivery stable. Escalate blockers with proposed options and trade-offs, not just problems. What we’re looking for: Required 3+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager or senior Business Analyst on backend, API-driven or platform products. Demonstrable experience writing requirements for systems where correctness, auditability and edge-case handling matter — authentication, identity, payments, compliance, or similar. Fluency with Agile delivery in practice: backlog management, Definition of Ready, refinement, estimation, sprint and release mechanics. Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence, including structuring EPICs, versions, labels and dashboards. Ability to read and reason about API documentation and system integration flows, and to hold a credible technical conversation with a Tech Lead without needing to code. Clear, structured written English — a large part of this role is producing documentation that other teams depend on. Comfort operating with multiple stakeholders and conflicting priorities, and the judgment to say no with a reason. Strongly preferred iGaming experience, particularly in player account management (PAM), responsible gaming, KYC/AML or regulatory reporting. Familiarity with regulated-market requirements across multiple jurisdictions. Exposure to authentication standards (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, SSO) and consent management. Experience supporting release processes and production incident handling. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Access to an Employee Assistance Program through TELUS Health. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool and gym? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! items.title: VP, Global Developer Relations
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As our VP of Global Developer Relations, you’ll be the voice and facilitator of Mistral to the developer, scientific, and technical communities. You’ll build and scale a global DevRel strategy that fosters deep engagement, advocacy, and love for Mistral’s models and technology. Your team will build communities and educate, excite, and empower developers to adopt, innovate, and evangelize Mistral’s technology—whether they’re startups, enterprises, researchers, or open-source contributors. You’ll work closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Marketing, Communications, and more to ensure developers have the tools, resources, and inspiration they need to succeed with Mistral. What You Will Do Build a Global Developer Movement - Develop and execute a global DevRel strategy that connects Mistral and our AI platform effectively with developers, scientists, and technologists. - Create authentic, developer-first engagement—focusing on education, inspiration, and community, with great content and AI tools. - Foster a culture of advocacy where developers naturally champion Mistral in their networks, projects, and conversations. Engage and Inspire the Technical Community - Lead high-impact developer engagement initiatives, including: - Technical content (e.g., tutorials, blog posts, videos, documentation) that helps developers get started, optimize, and innovate with Mistral’s models. - Community programs (e.g., hackathons, meetups, AMAs, Discord/Slack communities) that bring together AI builders, researchers, and enthusiasts. - Evangelism & thought leadership (e.g., conference talks, podcasts, technical deep dives) that showcase Mistral’s unique value and capabilities. - Work with Product and Research teams to translate complex AI innovations into accessible, exciting, and actionable insights for developers. Enable Developer Success, particularly for self-service adoption - Build scalable enablement programs (e.g., onboarding guides, SDKs, APIs, sample projects) that reduce friction for developers adopting Mistral’s models. - Create feedback loops between the developer community and Mistral’s Product/Engineering teams to shape the roadmap based on real-world needs. Scale a World-Class DevRel Team - Hire, mentor, and lead a global team of Developer Advocates, Engineers and Evangelists - with particular strength in Europe and San Francisco - Define metrics and KPIs to measure the impact of DevRel (e.g., developer adoption, community growth, engagement, advocacy). - Lead from the front as a fantastic representative of Mistral at events, in social, and in project communities Drive Open Source & Ecosystem Growth - Champion open-source contributions and collaborative innovation around Mistral’s models. - Partner with startups, enterprises, and academic institutions to accelerate adoption and co-innovation. - Identify and nurture key developer influencers, maintainers, and ambassadors who can amplify Mistral’s reach and impact. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven leadership in Developer Relations, Developer Marketing, or Technical Evangelism for a B2B technology company, preferably in AI, cloud, and open-source. - Deep technical credibility—ability to engage with developers, scientists, and engineers on their terms (e.g., code, research, architecture). - Passion for community building—a track record of growing and nurturing technical communities (e.g., open-source projects, developer forums, hackathons). - Strong storytelling and communication skills—ability to simplify complex concepts and inspire developers through content, talks, and interactions. - Strategic and operational excellence—ability to scale DevRel globally while maintaining a hands-on, authentic approach. - Collaborative mindset—ability to work across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to align DevRel with Mistral’s broader goals. Bonus Points If You Have - Experience in AI, machine learning, or large language models (LLMs). - Personally contributed meaningfully to open source projects and communities. - Led global DevRel teams in high-growth, competitive markets. - Personal brand or following in the developer or AI community Experience launching and scaling developer-focused products or tools. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Partner Development Manager - Japan
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? Adoption of AI is moving rapidly from pilots to production. Enterprises across APAC are investing in generative-AI programs, creating a once-in-a-decade market inflection point. At Cohere, we’re committed to transforming the Japan enterprise landscape through strategic partnerships and innovative AI solutions. As a Partner Development Manager for the Japan Enterprise Market, you’ll be at the heart of our mission to empower businesses across the region with cutting-edge AI technologies. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic, cross-cultural environment and is passionate about driving growth through collaboration. You’ll work closely with leading enterprises, system integrators, and technology partners to co-create value, expand market reach, and deliver impactful AI solutions tailored to the unique needs of Japanese businesses. Japan is a key strategic market for Cohere, and your work will directly contribute to our success in this region. You’ll have the opportunity to shape partnerships that drive digital transformation, foster innovation, and position Cohere as a leader in the Japan AI ecosystem. If you’re a strategic thinker, a relationship builder, and eager to make a meaningful impact in one of the world’s most dynamic markets, this role is your chance to shape the future of AI in Japan. As our Partner Development Manager - Japan, you will own the success of our partner relationships in Japan. Key responsibilities include: Partner Strategy & Execution - Define and execute Cohere’s partner-go-to-market plan for the Japan Enterprise Market, aligning with regional business objectives. - Partner with the broader GTM team to identify and recruit high-impact partners across system integrators, distributors, resellers, ISVs, and cloud providers. - Develop relationships with key stakeholders across the partner ecosystem to ensure success of the partnership. Partner Onboarding & Enablement - Lead partner onboarding, certification, and training programs to ensure partners are equipped to sell, deploy and manage Cohere’s solutions effectively. - Collaborate with enablement to scale partner enablement in Japan through sales and technical workshops, empowering them to deliver value to enterprise customers. Pipeline Generation & Co-Selling - Own joint pipeline generation by creating co-sell motions, solution plays, and strategic joint go-to market motions that align Cohere’s capabilities with enterprise mission needs and procurement cycles. - Collaborate with partners to identify and pursue high-value opportunities across key Japan segments Business Planning & Performance Tracking - Ensure partners are aligned with Cohere’s strategic goals and performance metrics. - Run joint business planning sessions and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with partners, tracking sourced and influenced ARR against targets. Partner Advocacy & Feedback - Serve as the voice of the partner within Cohere, relaying feedback to Product, Engineering, and Legal teams - Work with Cohere's Public Policy teams to navigate Japanese government AI policies to advise partners on risk management and responsible AI best practices. Thought Leadership & Evangelism - Evangelize Cohere’s vision and solutions at partner and industry events, positioning Cohere as a leader in responsible GenAI for the Japanese market. - Build thought leadership through briefings, speaking engagements, and collaborative initiatives. Why You’ll Love This Role This is a high-impact role where you’ll shape the future of AI partnerships in Japan. You’ll work at the intersection of technology, business, and policy, driving growth while ensuring responsible AI adoption. If you’re passionate about building strategic alliances, driving innovation, and making a difference in one of the world’s most dynamic markets, this is the role for you. What We’re Looking For - Native-level Japanese and business-level English fluency - 8+ years of experience in partner development, channel sales, or alliance management within the tech industry, preferably in AI or cloud solutions, with a track record of enterprise ARR contribution - Deep understanding of the Japanese enterprise market and key industry verticals. - Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with a track record of driving partner success. - Ability to navigate complex regulatory and compliance landscapes, including AI ethics and government policies. - Working understanding of AI (LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows) - Experience working with major system integrators, global consultancies, and hyperscalers including joint GTM and co-sell motions. Existing relationship with Fujitsu preferred. - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to evangelize Cohere’s vision to partners and industry stakeholders. - Results-driven growth mindset and bias for action. You thrive in a start-up-speed environment and enjoy building and scaling partner programs FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

Challenge Accepted? Check out the Betsson Group Blog to find out what our employees are talking about. items.title: Applied AI Architect, Partner
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams. Within the team, Partner Applied AI Architects work with strategic partners—including global and regional system integrators, consulting and advisory firms, and technology partners—to extend OpenAI’s technical reach and help partners deliver high-quality AI solutions for our joint customers. We bring together technical strategy, partner enablement, architecture expertise, and practical deployment experience, working closely with Partnerships, Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, and specialist delivery teams. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Partner Applied AI Architect, you will be a senior technical advisor to a portfolio of strategic partners and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership and delivery organizations. You will shape how partners build practices around OpenAI, develop solutions using our products, and take joint customers from AI opportunity and technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact. You will own the technical strategy and architecture across partner engagements involving ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with the Revenue Partnerships team, you will translate joint business priorities into technical strategies, solution patterns, enablement plans, and a focused portfolio of high-value customer opportunities. You will work directly with partners on strategic customer engagements—leading discovery, shaping architectures, navigating complex technical decisions, and helping secure technical wins—while building the partner capabilities required to deliver successfully and independently at scale. You will remain accountable for the technical quality and outcomes of the partnership while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, security, product, enablement, and other teams when deeper expertise is needed. The role calls for strong architectural judgment, executive presence, partner leadership, and the ability to move confidently between business strategy and hands-on technical conversations. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a portfolio of strategic partners, building trusted relationships with their executives, AI leaders, architects, engineering teams, and delivery organizations. - Partner closely with the Revenue Partnerships team as one virtual team, aligning partner strategy, technical priorities, joint customer opportunities, and measures of success. - Develop the technical strategy and plan for each partner, identifying priority solutions, use cases, technical capabilities, enablement needs, delivery risks, and opportunities to drive customer adoption. - Assess prospective and existing partners’ technical capabilities and delivery readiness, identifying strengths, gaps, and the investments required to successfully deliver OpenAI-powered solutions. - Lead technical discovery with partners and joint customers to identify, qualify, and prioritize AI use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes. - Develop clear Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, enterprise data, integrations, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment. - Collaborate with partner sales and technical teams on strategic opportunities, providing technical guidance through discovery, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, architectural recommendations, and proofs of value. - items.title: Operational Excellence & Enablement Manager
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE This role drives process improvement across Customer Operations, working alongside Fraud & Payments (FP), Responsible Gaming (RG), Customer Support (CS), and Anti-Money Laundering (AML). You will build a first-hand understanding of how each function operates, partner with key stakeholders to identify friction points and breakdowns, both internal and customer-facing, and prioritise high-impact fixes, starting with the gaps generating the highest volume of cross-departmental escalations. You will work with the relevant teams to redesign workflows, automate manual steps, and align on shared ways of working. Major initiatives are supported by the Ops Project Management team for tracking and delivery, with ownership shared between this role and the operational teams involved. This role also owns operational business reporting, working closely with the Director of Operational Excellence and Performance to give leadership timely, accurate performance insights. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: Process Discovery & Bottleneck Identification - Build and maintain a deep understanding of end-to-end workflows and handoffs across RFP, RG, CS, and AML. - Map cross-departmental processes to identify where handoffs break down, work stalls, or duplicate effort occurs. - Maintain a live, prioritized backlog of process issues weighted by frequency and business impact. Escalation-Led Prioritization - Track and analyze cross-departmental escalations to identify high-volume root causes. - Prioritize improvement initiatives based on internal impact and reduction of player friction (e.g., verification delays, payment holds, RG interventions). - Report escalation trends, root causes, and player-impact metrics to leadership. Process Redesign & Automation - Redesign processes end-to-end to address structural root causes. - Identify opportunities to eliminate manual effort and implement automation (workflow routing, RPA, AI-driven process improvements) in partnership with Product, Technology, and Process Improvement & Automation teams. - Build business cases for automation, establishing clear ROI, efficiency gains, and tracked hours saved. Operational Business Reporting - Own daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly operational performance reporting across Customer Operations in partnership with the Director of Operational Excellence and Performance. - Translate raw performance data into actionable strategic insights for leadership, highlighting key trends and risks. - Connect reporting metrics directly back to process improvement and automation initiatives to demonstrate tangible impact. Project Delivery & Operational Readiness - Drive major process and automation initiatives from problem identification through implementation. - Partner with the Ops Project Management team for milestone tracking and delivery support while holding accountability for change outcomes. - Ensure operational readiness prior to launch, including impact assessments, training needs, and complete documentation. Cross-Functional Alignment - Act as the connective link across RFP, RG, CS, AML, Product, Technology, and Compliance. - Facilitate alignment, resolve process ownership disputes early, and foster a continuous-improvement operational culture. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: - 3+ years of experience in iGaming or a similar fast-paced tech/operational industry. - Proven track record in process mapping, root-cause analysis, and cross-departmental process redesign. - Strong background in operational reporting, data visualization, and translating performance data into strategic business insights. - Hands-on familiarity with process automation tools, AI-driven operational tools, workflow routing, or RPA technologies. - Demonstrated experience collaborating across multi-functional operational teams (e.g., Fraud, Payments, Customer Support, Compliance). - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to navigate change management smoothly. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the iGaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and ground breakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 18 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Risk & Monitoring Analyst III
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Risk & Monitoring Analyst III on the Operational Risk and Controls team within Global Financial Crimes Operations, you'll own quality assurance reviews of Complaints case investigations, including formal, legal, and litigation matters, that support Coinbase's AML/CFT program. You'll strengthen consistency in case execution, surface procedural gaps, and partner across Operations, Compliance, Analytics, and Learning & Development to turn quality insights into measurable operational improvements. What you'll do: Complete weekly QA audit allocations in line with established procedures and grading standards, providing detailed documentation of errors identified and their root causes. Conduct root cause analysis and deep dives into operational procedures to identify recurring themes, knowledge gaps, and opportunities to upskill team performance across the Complaints function. Partner with stakeholders across CX, Compliance, Data Analytics, and L&D to close process gaps, launch workflow improvements, and enhance QA rubrics and frameworks. Build and present QA insights, recommendations, and performance metrics to Client Service Management and Complaints leadership, using data to drive prioritization and decision-making. Deliver impact analysis and project execution on process improvement initiatives, ensuring outcomes are documented and scalable across the function. Required Skills and Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in Complaints support, Quality Assurance, or Compliance Testing programs within financial services, with exposure across multiple compliance disciplines (e.g., Complaints, KYC, AML, TMS, or sanctions). Demonstrated ability to execute QA audits against established rubrics, identify error patterns, and translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve operational quality. Experience developing, producing, and presenting compliance metrics and reporting using tools such as Google Sheets, Excel, or Google Slides. Proven track record of partnering with cross-functional teams globally to implement process improvements and deliver work outcomes that meet quality and timeline standards. Full-time, in-office presence five days a week with availability to support extended hours when required by audit or compliance deadlines. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: Events Coordinator
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? Join one of the world's largest, most recognised names in online entertainment and take ownership of the events that bring our brands to life on a global stage. This is a central, high-impact role, planning and delivering community-driven events, industry conference activations and brand experiences that connect players, creators and community worldwide, as we move at speed with bold ambition. What you’ll build with us: Working closely with the Events Manager and cross-functional teams across Design, Marketing, Legal and Finance, you will own event delivery end to end, from initial scoping through to post-event reporting. Taking a brief and driving it forward with guidance on strategy and structure, and ensuring every activation lands on time, on brand and within budget across a fast-moving global calendar. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Own end-to-end coordination of assigned events, managing timelines, run-of-show documents and delivery checklists across multiple activations at once Coordinate booth logistics including floor space, furniture, branding, AV and on-site production, and manage setup through pack-down Source, brief and manage external vendors and suppliers, negotiating costs and tracking purchase orders and invoices to deliver within budget Partner with Design on booth creative and signage, align with Marketing's campaign calendars, and coordinate with Legal on venue and vendor agreements Keep stakeholders informed with clear updates on event status, risks and outcomes Plan community-facing activations, including experiential moments, competitions and giveaways that bring Easygo's brand to life Compile post-event reports covering attendance, budget reconciliation and key learnings, and identify ways to improve delivery over time Your track record: 2+ years in events coordination, production or a similar operational role Proven ability to manage multiple events simultaneously with strong attention to detail Proficiency in Google Workspace and confidence picking up new tools quickly (Easygo's events workflow runs on Jira and Confluence, Slack, Google Workspace, and Canva and Figma) Experience sourcing, briefing and managing external suppliers Excellent written and verbal communication skills Experience managing event budgets and PO processes Comfortable working across teams and with senior stakeholders Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment Bonus points if you also have: Background in gaming, streaming, esports or entertainment Experience coordinating logistics for events across multiple regions or time zones Basic proficiency in Canva or Adobe Creative Suite Familiarity with campaign management or digital marketing workflows Here are our benefits and perks: Sharpening your edge The ultimate sandbox. Exciting, on-the-job learning opportunities. 1 in 3 of our people level up their roles every year. If you deliver, you move. Competitive pay and bonus scheme Market-synced pay that respects your craft and location. Performance-based bonus recognition based on your impact (up to 20%). Help us build our crew and get paid for it with our high-value referral bonus. Because great people know great people. Other perks 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers Smooth Parental Return: Ease back into work with 12 weeks of transition support, including fully paid Fridays off during your first three months back Access to Employee Assistance Program Wednesday massages In-house baristas serve you free coffee, fresh juices and smoothies. Daily catered breakfast and regular company-wide events. Snack walls and drink fridges on every floor. Fun, modern office spaces. Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles and an F1 simulator. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.description: 【岗位职责】 一、交易聚合与路由 1.负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。 2.设计并实现路由算法与最优路径选择策略，平衡价格、滑点、Gas、成交概率等多目标。 3.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障高并发与网络拥堵场景下的稳定性与成功率。 二、询价与做市商接入 1.设计并实现询价（RFQ / Quote）系统，接入链上池子、链下做市商、CEX 等多类报价源。 2.负责做市商接入协议的设计与实现，覆盖报价订阅、更新、成交确认与风控校验。 3.构建报价质量评估与做市商分级机制，动态调整路由权重。 三、高并发与低延迟 1.优化询价、路由、交易链路的端到端延迟与吞吐能力。 2.设计交易风控与限流机制，覆盖滑点保护、价格偏离、重放保护、Gas 异常等场景。 【任职要求】 一、技术基础 1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。 2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。 3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。 具备低延迟、高并发系统的设计与优化经验。 4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。 5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。 熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。 6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。 7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。 8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。 9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。 二、AI 工程能力 1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。 2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。 3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。 【加分项】 1.有做市商系统、报价引擎、订单管理（OMS）相关的开发经验。 2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。 3.有跨链桥、跨链交易、Intent-based 交易（CoW、UniswapX、Across 等）相关的开发经验。 4.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。 5.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

items.title: Web3 研发工程师（资深）— 行情 / 数据中台方向
items.description: 【公司简介】 我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。 【岗位职责】 一、行情与实时数据系统 1.负责 Web3 行情系统的后端架构设计与开发，覆盖链上行情、DEX 池子数据、订单簿、成交流、K 线等多类实时数据的采集、清洗、聚合、存储与分发。 2.构建低延迟、高吞吐、可水平扩展的实时计算链路，保障行情数据在高并发场景下的稳定性、一致性与时效性。 3.设计并实现实时数据推送服务（WebSocket / gRPC Streaming 等），支撑前端、策略、交易等下游业务对实时行情的消费需求。 二、链上数据中台建设 1.负责链上数据中台的整体设计与落地，构建从节点接入、区块解析、事件解码到结构化存储的完整数据链路。 2.负责区块、交易、事件日志的解析与解码（Log Decode、Trace 解析、内部交易还原等），将原始链上数据转化为业务可消费的结构化数据。 3.抽象多链数据模型，沉淀通用的解析框架与数据资产，支撑行情、交易、钱包、预测市场等上层业务。 4.构建实时数据监控与报警机制，覆盖节点健康度、数据延迟、数据完整性、解析异常等关键指标。 【任职要求】 一、技术基础 1.5 年以上后端开发经验，语言 Java 或 Go 均可，熟悉 Java 者更佳 Java 方向：3 年以上 Java 实战经验，熟悉 JVM 调优、并发编程，掌握 Spring 生态。 Go 方向：3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。 2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。 3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。 4.具备实时计算系统的落地经验，熟悉状态管理、背压、容错、Exactly-Once 等机制；使用过 Akka 或 Pekko、Reactor（或 Project Reactor / RxJava）、Redis Stream。 5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理（共识、P2P、Gas / 手续费模型等），熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。 6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。 7.具备链上数据中台、行情系统或类似数据平台的项目经验，熟悉 Log Decode、ABI 解析、Trace / Internal Tx 处理等，主导过多链数据模型抽象或通用解析框架的建设。 8.主导过中大型后端系统或数据平台从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。 具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。 二、AI 工程能力 1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。 2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。 3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。 【加分项】 1.有大数据实时与离线计算经验（Flink、Spark、Storm 等），熟悉 Lambda / Kappa 架构。 2.有 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）池子状态维护、价格计算、聚合行情相关经验。 3.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、抢跑保护等相关经验。 4.有时序数据库（如 TimescaleDB、Druid、ClickHouse）在行情场景下的落地经验。 5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。 6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

items.description: 【岗位职责】 一、钱包账户体系 1.负责钱包账户系统的架构设计与演进，统一管理助记词、私钥、硬件、MPC、托管（Turnkey 等）、机器人钱包、保险箱等多类账户形态。 2.主导异构账户体系的融合与抽象，沉淀统一的账户模型与 Web3 ID 能力，支撑钱包及其他业务方的接入需求。 3.设计对外可接入的钱包能力，对其他业务线开放标准化的账户、签名、交易接口，避免业务方重复自建。 二、钱包核心服务 1.负责钱包核心后端服务的设计与开发，覆盖资产管理、代币列表、交易历史、上链广播、Gas 策略等关键链路。 2.负责大规模钱包数据（账户、资产、交易历史等亿级数据量）的存储设计、查询性能与版本兼容性。 3.负责钱包与中台基础能力（行情、Token、节点 RPC、资产）的集成与解耦，推动公共能力下沉、钱包业务上浮。 三、多链支持与上链 1.负责钱包多链支持的接入与维护，覆盖 EVM、Solana 及其他主流公链。 2.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障在网络拥堵、Nonce 冲突等场景下的稳定性。 【任职要求】 一、技术基础 1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。 2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。 3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理；具备亿级数据量场景下的存储设计与查询优化经验。 4.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地，具备账户、订单、资产等核心域的建模经验。 5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。 6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。 7.熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网钱包或交易系统的实战经验。 8.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。 二、钱包专项 1.熟悉主流钱包账户体系，包括助记词 / 私钥 / 硬件钱包 / MPC / 托管钱包等的原理与差异，理解各类账户的安全模型与使用场景。 2.具备钱包后端的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过账户系统、资产模块、交易历史等核心模块的设计与落地。 3.具备多账户体系融合、抽象与对外开放能力建设的经验，或对此方向有清晰的方法论。 三、AI 工程能力 1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。 2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。 3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。 【加分项】 1.有 MPC / TSS 钱包后端的开发经验，或熟悉 Turnkey、Fireblocks、Privy 等托管钱包方案。 2.有 AA 智能合约钱包（EIP-4337 / EIP-7702、Safe、Biconomy 等）相关的开发经验。 3.有亿级数据量下的数据迁移、版本兼容、双写切换等实战经验。 4.有钱包安全相关经验（密钥管理、签名风控、欺诈检测等）。 5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。 6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

items.title: Technical Operations Analyst, User Safety & Risk
items.description: About the Team At OpenAI, our User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO) team helps protect our products and users from abuse, fraud, safety risks, and other forms of misuse. We operate at the front line of real-world safety and risk management, translating user and operational signals into timely decisions, effective interventions, and improvements to our systems. Within USRO, Risk Incubation & Systems builds the analytics, automation, monitoring, quality mechanisms, and operating systems that help teams identify risk, make sound decisions, and scale safely. Our work spans emerging-risk detection, operational measurement, workflow automation, quality systems, launch readiness, and decision-support tools. We partner closely with operational teams as well as Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Safety, Legal, and Support to identify high-leverage opportunities and build practical systems that improve outcomes. About the Role We are hiring a Technical Operations Analyst to solve ambiguous, high-impact operational problems using data, technical tools, and strong judgment. You will work as an experienced individual contributor across USRO, moving from problem definition through analysis, workflow design, implementation, measurement, and handoff. The scope is intentionally broad and may span emerging-risk detection, operational quality, automation, launch readiness, and other priority programs. You will be expected to move between different problem areas as organizational needs evolve. This is a hands-on role. You should be comfortable querying and validating data, building dashboards and lightweight automations, using AI tools to accelerate work, and working directly with operators and technical partners to turn incomplete information into practical systems. Your work may also include data and operational monitoring issues for major cloud deployment partnerships—for example, validating pipelines and safety signals, investigating anomalies or discrepancies, improving reporting and escalation mechanisms, and documenting data limitations so partner teams can act with confidence. Location / work model: London, UK; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office. Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. items.title: Staff PLM & Engineering Applications Engineer, Consumer Devices
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Consumer Devices team at OpenAI builds end-to-end hardware and software systems that bring AI into the physical world. We work at the intersection of custom silicon, embedded systems, operating systems, cloud services, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and product design to deliver reliable, production-ready devices at scale. Within Consumer Devices, Hardware Engineering eXperience, or HEX, is a new bootstrapped team building the environments, applications, compute, product-data systems, and workflows that let hardware engineers do their work without needing to troubleshoot the machinery underneath. HEX owns virtual engineering environments, HPC/GPU compute, storage, networking, licensing, MCAD/ECAD/CAE applications, PLM, product data, automation, validation, and support as one connected system. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Staff PLM & Engineering Applications Engineer, you will be one of the first technical builders of HEX and the primary counterpart to the HEX lead. You will own the engineering-application and product-data side of the hardware engineering experience, with an initial focus on NX, Teamcenter, licensing, parts import, integrations, packaging, validation, and user workflows. This is not a traditional Teamcenter administration role and not a Corporate IT application-support role. You will take complex, fragile workflows and turn them into reliable engineering systems. This role is highly hands-on and systems-oriented. You will not inherit a mature environment and support queue. You will help build a fresh one, replacing manual setup guides, tribal knowledge, repeated support issues, and team handoffs with tested automation and reliable workflows. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Own the technical architecture, deployment, configuration, integration, validation, and long-term operation of NX and Teamcenter. - Build reliable workflows for parts import, product-data migration, metadata quality, BOMs, revisions, lifecycle states, and release processes. - Replace manual setup documentation with automated installation, configuration, validation, diagnostics, and recovery workflows. - Build tooling around NX, Teamcenter, MCAD, ECAD, CAE, plugins, licenses, and engineering environments. - Define and validate the golden path for hardware engineers: access, open, design, save, retrieve, release, simulate, and get help. - Partner with mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, simulation, manufacturing, systems, and product-design teams to understand where workflows break. - Work with Compute & Infrastructure-focused HEX Engineers so applications, product data, storage, VDI, HPC, and licenses feel like one coherent system. - Partner with contractors and vendors while keeping architecture, requirements, validation, acceptance, and long-term ownership inside HEX. - Build health checks, regression tests, observability, diagnostics, and support tooling that make failures easy to detect and recover from. - Help establish the technical standards, operating model, and engineering culture for the growing HEX organization. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have deep hands-on experience with Teamcenter, NX, PLM systems, and CAD workflows in a hardware product-development environment. - Have owned PLM architecture, data models, integrations, migrations, parts imports, release workflows, and engineering application platforms. - Can write automation in Python, PowerShell, Bash, and similar tools. - Have experience with packaging, deployment, licensing, validation, and application integrations. - Understand parts, revisions, BOMs, configurations, lifecycle states, and change workflows. - Can debug across applications, infrastructure, licenses, VDI, networking, storage, compute, and product data. - Prefer building durable tooling and automation instead of managing ticket queues. - See a four-page setup guide and immediately want to replace it with a tested installer. - Are comfortable in a new bootstrapped team where the environment, standards, workflows, and operating model are still being built. - Can work directly with engineers, understand their pain, and turn repeated problems into reliable systems. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS - Experience with Teamcenter Active Workspace, BMIDE, ITK, SOA/REST, and Teamcenter customization. - Experience with NX Open, managed mode, customer defaults, templates, licensing, packaging, and upgrades. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience with PLM migrations, legacy part imports, data cleanup, ERP integrations, and ECAD integrations. - Experience with MCAD, ECAD, CAE/FEA, HPC, VDI/AVD, GPU workstations, and engineering storage. - Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, infrastructure automation, and self-service systems. - Experience in complex hardware-development environments, including consumer devices, robotics, automotive, aerospace, or embedded systems. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. In this role, you will design, build, integrate, and validate the software used to manufacture, qualify, and deliver our hardware from the factory. You will work across the stack to create the infrastructure that runs internally and externally to coordinate all aspects of the production process. You will create the critical tools and procedures to execute, capture, process, and present the data resulting from the end to end assembly and validation of our hardware across multiple vendors and sites. This role is hands-on and high-ownership. You will work closely across teams both internal and external to define the standards that will be used across our products to ensure the velocity and quality of our 1P hardware. You will own the implementation, deployment, and output of these systems as well their continued maintenance and SLAs. Location: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid: 3 days/week onsite). items.title: Technical Compliance Specialist
items.description: On average it takes 5 minutes to apply for this role. Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Do you see yourself as one of those “out-of-the-box thinkers”, “Technical masterminds”, “Outstanding creatives”, or “Mind-boggling number crunchers”? If so, we want to welcome you to the Betway family and celebrate what makes you unique! Our global customer base is exploding and we need your skills to support us on this exciting journey! Don’t look back and submit your application before the opportunity passes you by.. Who we are We’re Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands, including Betway and Jackpot City. We’re a powerhouse built on decades of expertise and we’re changing the game for good. Our mission is to give our customers a superclass entertainment experience. Who we’re looking for We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Super Group International, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar. Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary. Why we need you We’re building experiences that wow our customers – and that starts with bold, curious people who want to do work that matters. If you’re hungry to grow, excited by impact and ready for a challenge that will supercharge your career, this could be your moment. As a Technical Compliance Specialist , you’ll play a key role in ensuring our systems and platforms meet the technical standards required across multiple regulated markets. You’ll develop strong expertise in regulatory technical requirements, manage end‑to‑end technical incidents — from assessment and resolution to reporting and ongoing monitoring — and act as an escalation point for all technical compliance matters. You’ll provide clear, compliant options to internal and external stakeholders, maintain an accurate technical incident register, and deliver detailed incident reports outlining root cause, impact and resolution. Your work will help safeguard the integrity, stability and regulatory readiness of our technical environment. What you’ll do You’ll take ownership of work that gives us our competitive edge, including: Develop & maintain a solid knowledge of technical requirements to comply with online gambling legislation & regulations for multiple markets Execute end-to-end incident management including assessment, resolution, reporting & on-going monitoring Act as an escalation point for all technical compliance matters, providing clear, practical advice to the business Provide compliant options to internal & external stakeholders on how to resolve technical incidents Maintain an accurate technical incident register Provide technical incident reporting which clearly outlines the cause, effect, resolution Support operational teams to maintain compliant, stable and effective technical functionality This list covers your core responsibilities – with plenty of room to stretch, explore and take on new challenges as we grow. What you’ll bring You’re someone who brings: Clear, confident communication (written and verbal), and the ability to breakdown complex ideas A collaborative mindset, working smoothly with cross‑functional teams to hit shared goals Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects without dropping the ball Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to high‑quality work Adaptability – you stay sharp, productive and positive in fast‑moving environments Proven experience working in a dynamic team, with complex casework Strong understanding of both remote regulatory requirements in various jurisdictions, ensuring adherence to legal standards Expertise in managing multiple tasks simultaneously, with a track record of delivering on time and within scope A self-motivated approach, with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of tasks A curious, problem-solving mindset and the confidence to ask the right questions Desirable skills you’ve got up your sleeve It would be great if you also have some the following skills: In-depth knowledge of sports betting markets, including odds calculation, betting types and market trends Previous experience in the online or land-based gaming or casino industry, with a strong understanding of player behaviour and industry regulations Familiarity with gambling regulations and compliance requirements in various jurisdictions, ensuring adherence to legal standards Experience using back-office systems to review, investigate and support technical compliance queries Strong Excel skills to manage, analyse and present technical compliance data clearly Experience analysing data to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement Basic coding knowledge to support technical investigations and process improvements Experience working in a technical or incident management role within the online gaming industry Our values are non-negotiables Our culture is underpinned by core values that are linked to key behavioural competencies. Along with the below behavioural competencies, these are essential for all employees in order for you to embed in and drive our culture forward. These competencies are: Adaptability Ownership and accountability Initiating action Resilience Team orientation Integrity Innovation What you’ll get back We invest in your growth and wellbeing, so you can bring your best: Supergrowth is real here. Our learning and development programmes give you the tools, training and opportunities to level up fast. Your progress matters . Our Performance tool ensures you get meaningful feedback to support your development and superdrive your career. Support that has your back . Our Employee Assistance Programme offers resources for you and your family. Private Health Care Life Insurance Income Protection Ready to feel superclass? At Super Group, your experience matters. We’re honest, fair, and focused on helping you succeed – and your work will have real impact from day one. Game on! Should you not hear from us within 2 weeks, please assume your application has not been successful.
